notes.title: Sept. Update schedule change Notice
notes.notes: [p]Hello Masters, this is MilkEmpire.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]The content update originally scheduled for September has been postponed to October.[/u][/b][/p][p]We sincerely apologize to everyone who was looking forward to it and appreciate your patience.[/p][p][/p][p]The main reason for the delay is to make sure the new content reaches a higher level of quality and polish.[/p][p]In addition, we've decided to work on supporting additional resolutions and Steam Deck compatibility, which many Masters have requested since release.[/p][p]Accordingly, the roadmap will be partially revised, and we'll share more details in a future post.[/p][p][/p][p]We'll do our very best to live up to the support and love you've shown for \[Maid Survivors : Little Angels].[/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: What?! Mallet Turret is evolving!
notes.notes: [p]Hello Masters, this is MilkEmpire.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The weapon \[Mallet] is getting a brand-new gimmick![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Previously, it summoned a "Monk Turret" regardless of its level.[/p][p][b][u]From now on, it will summon the "Little Genie" series, which upgrades as the \[Mallet] level increases![/u][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859554/2b7d4976ee87ee1cd95f24946d8fb39f51063f9c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859554/fae99fa2d96e32332f91786e0b6275cce3e9444b.png"][/img][/p][p]The Little Genie series also changes its attack style depending on its level.[/p][p](Note: Damage and other stats may be adjusted later for balance.)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859554/39e5f49788be3eeef13ab2ac9f633e95329abab8.gif"][/img][/p][p][b][i]Level 4 Little Genie even comes with an autonomous action mode![/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]The \[Mallet]'s Little Genie summon gimmick will be added with the bug-fix patch scheduled for September 3–5![/p][p][/p][p]Please keep your eyes on Little Angels with lots of interest and love♥[/p]

notes.title: Hold tight, we're FIXING things up!

notes.title: Demo Update : v0.47
notes.notes:
Hello Masters! This is MilkEmpire.

Maid Survivors : Little Angels' new Demo is updated on Oct 17th, 13:00pm (KST)!


Main features for this demo:

1. Redesigned several game screen UI.
2. Added an unlock system.
3. Added Maid-warrior 'passive skill'.
4. Added flavor texts for items.
5. Some weapons and items have been adjusted.
6. Bug fixes.

About the unlock system:
With the update of the unlock system, playable maid-warriors are limited to 3 (Otohime, Hotaruko, and Genius).
Please note that the unlock system is not yet fully developed.
We plan to include more diverse and attractive unlock features in the final release of the game.

We're going to continuously update the demo until the full-version release, so please keep an eye on it with lots of interest and love!!!

notes.title: Demo Update : v0.45
notes.notes:
Hello Masters! This is MilkEmpire.

Little Angels : Maid Survivors' a new demo just updated on June 27th at 19:00(KST)!!!

New additions, improvements, and several bug fixes in below have been made.

New Additions
1. Steam achievements
2. Stage 1 Hard Mode
3. Kanekuma's Stage 1 story
4. Beginning of the Main story
(※The conversation between Genius and Moriika in the Little Angel lobby after the tutorial has been changed to the conversation between Otohime and Moriika that reflects the main story.)
5. Language selection pop-up at game start (appears only once when the game is first open)
6. 1 new normal monster in Stage 1

Improvements and bug fixes
1. Monster knockback applied to Otohime's Dodge skill
2. Monster knockback applied to Kanekuma's Dodge skill
3. Bug fix where a red effect remains on the screen during the dialogue event CG after clearing the stage while the player's HP is low
4. Bug fix where the receiving damage during the boss battle phase 2 cut scene
5. Bug fix where some weapons and items appear in the shop with the wrong tier
6. Bug fix in the tutorial shop guide
7. Genius Special Service fixed the issue of taking damage during a cut scene
8. Bug fix where damage was not taken when overlapping with a monster
9. Bug fix where maid status did not immediately update after level-up upgrades or item purchases, etc.
10. Corrected minimum damage display for player's attacks (the issue where player attacks were displayed as minus damage in field)
11. Some minor bugs fixed
12. Some effects chaged and added
